name: Privet, menya zovut Sam!
source:
Samsung Sam, the failed mascot of the mega-corporation, gains a new life, but in a completely new format: Sam is transported into the Soviet pioneer camp "Sovyonok", where she will fit right in alongside other well-known girls. But who is she really, and how did a digital dummy end up in the world of Everlasting Summer?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2877079097]Steam[/url]]
